# monotaur_component (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur component by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_component" "api_server" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the component to look up.

### Read-Only

- `business_hours_id` (String) ID of the business hours schedule associated with this component.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the component was created.
- `label_ids` (List of String) IDs of labels associated with this component.
- `maintenance_window_ids` (List of String) IDs of maintenance windows associated with this component.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) IDs of monitors associated with this component.
- `name` (String) The display name of the component.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the component was last updated.
